value.evidence: The delivered email explains tasks and teammate mentions, but does not establish how an agency handles work separately across different clients.

customer_effort.evidence: The default interface supplied the objective, audience and Fast preset.

human_work.evidence: The run left an editorial objection about the agency workflow. A human edit was not applied.

reliability.evidence: One of one requested emails delivered. The first draft was factually blocked and the automatic rewrite passed, with editorial review still requested.

usability.evidence: Real UI text download and HTML preview. The UI acknowledged HTML copy. The saved HTML rendered at 390 and 1280 pixels with the same signup link, which opened the real form.

reuse.evidence: The generation reused the compiled knowledge. A subsequent campaign was not evaluated.
